artifacts.license: Upstream distro licenses of the bundled glibc/libstdc++ libraries
artifacts.notes: Official Box64 v0.4.2 release asset. Supplies the x86_64 glibc/libstdc++ guest libraries BDS links against. Point BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH at its lib directory.

unavailable.proot: Official Ubuntu ARM64 package exists, but is a .deb and requires ar+tar.xz extraction; no official standalone current ARM64 binary with a published digest was found.
unavailable.box64: No upstream standalone Android ARM64 executable is published; it must be built by .github/workflows/runtime-build.yml and attached to a runtime-v* Release before it can be pinned here.
unavailable.bds: Official Mojang Linux download exists and is x86_64; it must be downloaded after the user accepts Mojang terms and its version-specific checksum must be supplied from a trusted source.
